roadmap_note: Preserve these designs for later. The active v0.8 MVP reuses the original four v0.7 case packets and five controlled conditions; none of D02-D08 is being implemented now.

cases.title: Validation-contaminated preprocessing with clean replay
cases.important_failure: The apparent validation result used reference fitting that included validation information; the agent must contain it and use a clean replay before deciding.
cases.professional_importance: A model can appear perfect when normalization or feature construction sees validation data. Diligence must separate an invalid result from the recoverability of the underlying asset.
available_evidence: sealed clean-replay predictions purchasable under budget
required_calculations: patient-level discrimination, calibration and net benefit for the original export
the same metrics for the clean replay
patient and site sensitivities using the committed method
cases.consequential_choice: Whether to buy the pipeline replay and whether to stop or continue bounded research development after it returns.
defensible_choices: pause and buy the inexpensive clean replay
stop immediately only if the decision contract makes recovery valueless
continue conditionally if the clean replay remains valid and claims stay bounded
cases.real_harm_from_error: Contaminated evidence advances a non-performing asset, or a recoverable signal is discarded without testing.
cases.verifier_recomputation: Rebuild patient rows from raw identifiers, inspect actual fit membership and event order, and recompute both original and replay metrics with the agent's committed aggregation, ECE bins and uncertainty settings.

mission_critical_science: detect validation information in preprocessing
mark the original result ineligible
analyse the clean replay
revise the decision in the direction supported by the replay
accepted_professional_alternative: patient bootstrap or defensible hierarchical uncertainty
fixed-bin ECE or calibration intercept/slope if prospectively declared
stop rather than purchase when the written business contract makes recovery immaterial
diagnostic_only: exact prose used to describe leakage

hidden_variants.revealed_difference: The clean replay loses discrimination, calibration and utility.
The clean replay retains decision-relevant performance.

failure_interventions.observed_failure: detected leakage but could not design a clean replay

contract_trap_audit.difficulty_source: contamination detection plus belief revision after counterfactual replay

cases.title: Repeated biopsies and the patient analysis unit
cases.important_failure: Biopsy rows are treated as independent patients, inflating effective sample size and potentially discrimination.
cases.professional_importance: Repeated tissue samples are common in translational studies. Incorrect independence assumptions produce false precision and can change model-selection decisions.
available_evidence: biopsy manifest with reported and fingerprint-derived identities
cases.consequential_choice: Whether the evidence can advance at patient level or must pause for identity reconciliation.
defensible_choices: aggregate repeated baseline biopsies prospectively
fit a defensible repeated-measures model
pause when patient identity cannot be resolved
cases.real_harm_from_error: Pseudoreplicated evidence is presented as independent validation and a weak predictor is advanced.
cases.verifier_recomputation: Reconstruct fingerprint-defined patient clusters, independently aggregate locked predictions, bootstrap patients rather than rows, and compare row and patient estimates.

mission_critical_science: identify the patient as the decision unit
preserve within-patient dependence
base the decision on patient-level results
accepted_professional_alternative: mean, median or prespecified first locked biopsy
cluster bootstrap or hierarchical repeated-measures model
diagnostic_only: row-level AUC when clearly labelled descriptive

hidden_variants.revealed_difference: Patient aggregation removes the apparent performance advantage.
Patient-level estimates remain adequate with honest uncertainty.

failure_interventions.observed_failure: agent calculates row-level uncertainty despite known repeats

contract_trap_audit.difficulty_source: choosing and executing the correct biological unit of analysis

cases.title: Hospital/site confounding versus transportable signal
cases.important_failure: Pooled performance is driven by hospital-specific prevalence, acquisition or batch structure rather than within-site biology.
cases.professional_importance: Clinical biomarker studies frequently confound site, prevalence and assay batch. A pooled AUC can look strong while failing at every deployable site.
available_evidence: one constrained external-site or same-site enlargement option
cases.consequential_choice: Whether to buy evidence from a new site, enlarge the same sites, or conclude that current evidence is sufficient.
defensible_choices: hierarchical site model
site-stratified estimates with explicit uncertainty
matched external-site validation when current sites cannot distinguish transport
cases.real_harm_from_error: A hospital identifier masquerades as biological signal and fails at deployment.
cases.verifier_recomputation: Recompute patient-level pooled, within-site and site-balanced metrics and test whether outcome/prediction structure is explained by site composition.

mission_critical_science: inspect site-outcome-prediction dependence
avoid advancing on pooled performance alone
choose evidence that can test transport
accepted_professional_alternative: hierarchical partial pooling
site-stratified estimates
leave-one-site-out analysis

hidden_variants.revealed_difference: New-site and within-site performance are poor despite strong pooled AUC.
Within-site and new-site estimates remain directionally consistent.

contract_trap_audit.difficulty_source: separating pooled association from within-site transportability

cases.title: Endpoint, visit and label-provenance reconciliation
cases.important_failure: Training and validation labels refer to different clinical constructs or time windows, with ambiguous patient/visit linkage.
cases.professional_importance: Response, remission and mucosal healing are not interchangeable, and biopsy-to-visit joins can silently attach a valid outcome to the wrong intended use.
required_calculations: eligible patient count under the intended window
performance under each defensible endpoint construction
cases.consequential_choice: Whether metadata reconciliation is enough, clinical adjudication is needed, or the existing endpoint cannot support the claim.
defensible_choices: use the prospectively contracted endpoint
report multiple endpoint constructions without selecting after outcomes
abstain when no endpoint is clinically aligned
cases.real_harm_from_error: A predictor for a different clinical outcome is represented as treatment-response evidence.
cases.verifier_recomputation: Rebuild patient/visit joins from source dates, reconstruct each disclosed endpoint, and recompute performance and decision rules under the eligible definitions.

mission_critical_science: identify endpoint and time-window compatibility
reconcile labels at the patient/visit level
limit claims to the supported endpoint
accepted_professional_alternative: dual-review adjudication
prespecified composite endpoint
parallel sensitivity endpoints with no post-hoc promotion
diagnostic_only: preferred clinical terminology when definitions are explicit

hidden_variants.revealed_difference: Source reconciliation shows the apparent mismatch was a visit-key alias and the contracted endpoint is recoverable.
Clinical adjudication confirms a different endpoint construct and window.

failure_interventions.observed_failure: clinical meaning remains ambiguous after linkage

contract_trap_audit.difficulty_source: distinguishing resolvable metadata error from a clinically different endpoint

cases.title: Cross-platform transcriptomic transport
cases.important_failure: A predictor is transferred across assay platforms with incompatible feature mappings, preprocessing references or dynamic range.
cases.professional_importance: Gene-level overlap does not guarantee that a locked score transports across probes, library preparation or normalization systems.
available_evidence: bridge samples assayed on both platforms
required_calculations: performance after a training-only bridge transformation
cases.consequential_choice: Whether the current locked predictor can be evaluated as transported, needs a bridge study, or must be redeveloped on the target platform.
defensible_choices: training-only bridge calibration
probe-level mapping with ambiguity exclusions
platform-specific redevelopment when mapping is not identifiable
cases.real_harm_from_error: Technical scale differences are mistaken for patient biology, producing misleading external validation.
cases.verifier_recomputation: Reapply the declared feature map and bridge fit using training/bridge data only, confirm no target outcomes enter it, and recompute concordance, calibration and target metrics.

mission_critical_science: audit feature and preprocessing compatibility
keep target outcomes out of the bridge fit
condition transport claims on bridge evidence
accepted_professional_alternative: gene-level aggregation
locked affine bridge
platform-specific recalibration with an independent validation split

hidden_variants.revealed_difference: A training-only bridge restores calibration and preserves ranking on target samples.
Technical concordance is adequate but target-platform clinical signal collapses.

contract_trap_audit.difficulty_source: separating technical bridge failure from biological non-transport

cases.title: High discrimination with poor calibration or harmful utility
cases.important_failure: An impressive AUC is treated as sufficient despite miscalibrated probabilities or negative utility at the proposed treatment threshold.
cases.professional_importance: Clinical decisions consume probabilities and thresholds, not rankings alone. A model can rank well and still worsen decisions.
available_evidence: training-only recalibration or matched external-evidence option
required_calculations: confusion counts and net benefit or expected utility
cases.consequential_choice: Whether recalibration is enough, threshold use must pause, or ranking-only research can continue.
defensible_choices: recalibrate using independent training data
change the threshold only under a declared utility contract
continue ranking research while prohibiting probability or threshold claims
cases.real_harm_from_error: Patients receive a harmful decision rule despite an attractive retrospective AUC.
cases.verifier_recomputation: Recompute discrimination, calibration, confusion counts and utility from patient artifacts, then independently apply the declared recalibration or threshold policy without validation refitting.

mission_critical_science: evaluate calibration and utility with discrimination
respect the prespecified action-cost contract
bound claims when only ranking is supported
accepted_professional_alternative: net benefit or explicit expected utility
calibration curve plus intercept/slope or prespecified ECE
pause threshold use while continuing ranking research

hidden_variants.revealed_difference: Training-only recalibration restores decision utility on untouched validation data.
Calibration or prevalence shift leaves negative utility across the defensible threshold range.

failure_interventions.observed_failure: probability scale is wrong but ranking is stable
agent equates AUC with clinical usefulness
failure_interventions.candidate_resource: decision-curve tool and clinical utility contract

contract_trap_audit.difficulty_source: integrating ranking, probability accuracy and decision consequences

cases.title: Sample identity and label-provenance integrity
cases.important_failure: Swapped samples, duplicated exports or ambiguous source labels make prediction-outcome joins unreliable.
cases.professional_importance: A statistically correct analysis is meaningless if molecular samples and clinical outcomes do not refer to the same people and visits.
available_evidence: bounded curator crosswalk or re-assay option
required_calculations: performance before and after defensible quarantine/reconciliation
worst-case decision sensitivity for unresolved records
cases.consequential_choice: Whether to quarantine records, buy source reconciliation, re-assay samples, or stop because identity cannot be recovered.
defensible_choices: quarantine only affected records with sensitivity bounds
use a source-record crosswalk
stop when identity uncertainty can reverse the decision
cases.real_harm_from_error: Predictions are validated against another patient's outcome and the resulting evidence cannot be trusted.
cases.verifier_recomputation: Reconstruct the identity graph from fingerprints and logs, verify one-to-one patient/visit joins, and recompute results after each defensible reconciliation or quarantine set.

mission_critical_science: detect identity or label provenance conflicts
prevent unresolved joins from entering confirmatory metrics
quantify whether uncertainty changes the decision
accepted_professional_alternative: quarantine with bounds
probabilistic linkage with a prespecified confidence rule
full source reconciliation

hidden_variants.revealed_difference: The curator crosswalk resolves every consequential mismatch and corrected evidence remains valid.
Several high-leverage samples cannot be assigned to patients and decision bounds cross the threshold.

contract_trap_audit.difficulty_source: propagating identity uncertainty into the scientific decision

cases.title: Competing explanations, constrained value of information and justified action
cases.important_failure: The agent notices weak evidence but cannot choose the smallest affordable experiment that distinguishes the live explanations; in the sufficient branch it escalates unnecessarily.
cases.professional_importance: Diligence is an investment decision. Buying more of the wrong evidence wastes time, while universal caution can be as damaging as reckless advancement.
available_evidence: endpoint, site and platform diagnostics supporting two live mechanisms
resource catalog with costs, delays, returned artifacts and limitations
required_calculations: decision bounds under each live explanation
which resource result would change the action
cases.consequential_choice: Buy one constrained resource or buy nothing, then advance, pause or stop at a clearly stated development stage.
defensible_choices: any resource on the predeclared near-optimal decision-value frontier
buy nothing when current evidence already determines the bounded action
stop early when every affordable resource is non-resolving
cases.real_harm_from_error: The program buys reassuring but irrelevant evidence, or misses a time-sensitive valid opportunity through unnecessary abstention.
cases.verifier_recomputation: Recompute the quantities each resource can affect, compare actions under every returned result, verify event order and budget, and evaluate the final explicit decision object against the complete evidence chain.

mission_critical_science: retain at least two live explanations
choose a resource that can distinguish them or justify none
predeclare result-contingent actions
revise the final decision according to returned evidence
accepted_professional_alternative: formal expected value of sample information
qualitative dominance/Pareto analysis with explicit assumptions
no purchase when no affordable result can change the action

hidden_variants.revealed_difference: The near-optimal resource resolves the first hypothesis but exposes a consequential second blocker.
All decision-critical evidence is already present; available resources only repeat or delay it.

failure_interventions.observed_failure: resource choice does not distinguish hypotheses
agent cannot translate evidence into the next experiment
correct calculations but repeated failure to execute contingent decisions

contract_trap_audit.difficulty_source: choosing and acting on the smallest decision-relevant experiment under genuine ambiguity
